## Reviewer feedback

> The Risks section is useful, but please group or order the risks by owner so the list is easier to scan. Keep the change limited to the Risks section.

## Task

Use your AI assistant to:

1. explain the feedback in plain language;
2. propose the smallest update;
3. identify which files should change;
4. implement only after you review the plan;
5. validate the result.

Add the resulting commit to the same branch and pull request used for the Risks exercise.
